note: The decoded gate row this recipe reached when it was pinned (npm run qa:cover-recipes re-renders it and fails when median d or the moving share leave +-15 %, seamLocal leaves TARGET or the file passes 2 MiB). Measured 2026-10-20 on headless Chrome's software rung and libwebp 1.6.0.

treatment.request: A README motion cover for LitCodex where the name itself moves.
treatment.idea: A wave of weight rolls through the name and through faint rows of it that drift one word per loop.
treatment.recipeReason: The name is the material, so the motion happens inside the letters.

layers.slow: Background rows drift one word length per loop, alternate rows opposite ways.
layers.mid: A weight swell offset by x and y crosses every letter once per loop.
layers.beat: A caret steps under each letter of the name with an overshoot and returns home.

system.rule: Letter weight is a gain-shaped swell of the loop phase.
system.copies: About 500 background letters and the eight letters of the name.
system.offset: 0.85 x / W + 0.35 y / H plus a little loop noise per row.

treatment.ambition: The tide reads as one wave through many copies and the name never thins below a readable weight.
